name: Bazaar Tokens: an account earns at most 1250 per hour
contract: With CoA.BazaarTokens.HourlyCap.Amount 1250 and WindowSeconds 3600 (defaults) an account earns at most 1250 Bazaar Tokens (975001) in the hour that its first earned token opens. A level-60 Human at 1210 earned tokens turns in Scarlet Sweep: Magic and Might (18034, 50 tokens beside 2000 Runes of Ascension 375250): only the remaining 40 are paid, the runes in full, and the player is told the limit is reached. At the limit, completing and turning in Winterfall Purge (17926, 40 tokens plus the Ethereal Bazaar's 0-6 for completing it) pays no tokens and still its 2000 runes. Tokens added directly (as a GM .additem does) are not limited. Once the hour that opened 61 minutes ago has run out, Duel! (80651) pays its 40 tokens plus 0-6 again. Limiting tokens per hour is a Rexxar choice, not live Ascension behaviour.
